text: All **seven direct members of the native catechol class** were inspected using complete originals, with shared modules and the broader meta umbrella also checked. PWY-5415 is the five-step hydrolytic alternative; PWY-5417 is the ortho route, and CATECHOL-ORTHO-CLEAVAGE-PWY is its upstream four-step module. PWY-5431 combines ortho catechol/protocatechuate branches. GO:0019616 is broader than either meta variant. The fresh KEGG M00569 original explicitly combines hydrolytic/oxidative and catechol/methylcatechol alternatives. Neither is an exact replacement for PWY-5420.
disposition: Native discovery distinguishes PWY-5417 parent containing the four-step child and PWY-2361 tail from PWY-5420 oxidative meta and PWY-5431 branch umbrella. Source definition is a candidate lead, not a maintained record.
